aap: AAP plans and annual analytical workpapers spanning FY2008 forward
Applicant logs by fiscal year through 2026-2027
Historical workforce, incumbency, availability, hiring, termination and personnel-activity analyses
eeo: EEO employee lists by fiscal year (restricted)
title_vi_lep: Title VI/LEP plans and historical versions

privacy_rules: Do not persist names from filenames of restricted completed forms/cases.
Do not copy applicant logs, employee rosters, payroll rows, voluntary EEO demographics, EEOC case narratives, or individual accommodation facts into generalized knowledge.
Aggregate plan analyses may be retained when they do not identify individuals.
Blank templates and position-level policies may be preserved in full.
duplicate_examples: The 2018 Driver Training & Orientation source appears repeatedly in historical AAP folders and is already canonical in the RTEC HR library.
The Sexual Harassment Complaint Form appears in multiple plan folders and should be referenced to one canonical source.
Several Title VI reference/web assets are exact duplicates across exported web-page folders.
